svg.title: Line of sight — 025 / What the room does not have — Reader
svg.desc: Fog of war, Line of sight: 025 / What the room does not have, Reader. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 hatched. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response hatched, correction hatched, configuration hatched, weights dark, staging hatched. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Shaded relief with a soft, irregular fog edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Many pictograms lie draped on the ground beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: 025 / What the room does not have
ONE FORM OF EACH FAMILY SHOWN / ALL LIE UNDER THE FOG
THE READER CARRIES PAGE 024 INTO A ROOM THAT DOES NOT HAVE IT.
024; 025.4 / staged plugin and persistent users documented; boundary inferred · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC RELIEF / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
